recommendation: Keep the audit commit. If Pharmacy wants medication image support in an active R6 core resource or an external formulary/knowledge IG, create a new current-scope work-group decision rather than replaying this R5 MedicationKnowledge change into Medication.
issue_request: FHIR-22828 requested a way to represent reference images of dispensed medication pills. Its Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution directed adding Attachment to drugCharacteristic.value, clarifying definitions, and adding image to the drugCharacteristic.type value set.
initial_application: Commit f5adcd0ed5 (GF #22828) applied the request by adding image to medicationknowledge-characteristic and updating the MedicationKnowledge spreadsheet so drugCharacteristic.value[x] allowed Attachment. Later XML source refactoring preserved Attachment support in MedicationKnowledge.definitional.drugCharacteristic.value[x].
additional_context: In the current build, source/fhir.ini lists Medication as an active resource but no longer lists MedicationKnowledge in [resources]; commit 5a4307d78b removed MedicationKnowledge from active build configuration. The retained MedicationKnowledge value set points at the THO medicationknowledge-characteristic code system, which still includes image. Current Medication has no drugCharacteristic element, and no direct Zulip or Confluence evidence was found that would justify broadening the R5 MedicationKnowledge application into a new R6 Medication change.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source files were edited because the historical change is present in retained MedicationKnowledge/terminology evidence, while the resource is outside current core build scope and active Medication has no approved drugCharacteristic surface for this issue.

related_jiras.note: R6 medication module page work reorganized normative and additional resources and reinforces that the current module surface is not the old MedicationKnowledge resource; it was context only and was not decided here.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue requesting medication pill image support by allowing Attachment on drugCharacteristic.value and adding image to drugCharacteristic.type.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final R5 WG request and the intended drugCharacteristic-based application target.

evidence_items.summary: GF #22828 added the image concept to medicationknowledge-characteristic and updated MedicationKnowledge drugCharacteristic.value[x] to include Attachment.
evidence_items.learned: The historical application exists and was made against MedicationKnowledge, not active Medication.

evidence_items.summary: Retained MedicationKnowledge source includes Attachment on definitional.drugCharacteristic.value[x], and its characteristic value set includes the THO code system.
evidence_items.learned: The source refactor preserved the key part of the FHIR-22828 application in retained MedicationKnowledge source.

evidence_items.summary: The current THO code system includes the image concept with display Image and definition Description of the Image of the product.
evidence_items.learned: The terminology half of the FHIR-22828 resolution remains present in the external terminology source used by the value set.

evidence_items.summary: Medication is active in [resources], MedicationKnowledge is absent, and commit 5a4307d78b removed MedicationKnowledge build entries.
evidence_items.learned: MedicationKnowledge is outside the current core build scope, so editing its retained source is not a current-spec fix.
